name: BODY-CAM
tagline: Serve a warrant at 1147 Elm St. through a body camera lens. Clear the house, room by room.
description:
**BODY-CAM** is a single-player, first-person shooter that plays out through the fisheye lens of an Axon Body 3 camera, complete with a running timestamp, unit ID and a blinking REC indicator. You are part of a SWAT element on a warrant service at **1147 Elm St.**, and your orders are simple: **clear the house**.

Inside, the house is dim and decaying: peeling paint, stained walls, bullet holes, and debris scattered across the floor. Your rifle and holographic sight lead the way around every doorframe and corner. A tracker in the corner of the screen counts **suspects (0/7)** and shows your current objective, starting with the entry.

From the staging area, rack the charging handle to start the mission. Check the **Field Manual** for controls and procedures, and use **Settings** to tune the lens, sensitivity and audio. Play in real time with keyboard and mouse or a controller.
